title: vtc spec: recording pause capability, push-mode schemes, layout (from broadcast research)
description: From docs/design/vtc-broadcast-research.md (JMAP-po6q.3-.5). For jmap-chat-spec (xpzz is closed): S1 add supportsRecordingPause (pause fits only GStreamer natively); S2 livestreamPushSchemes + streamKey placement per protocol; G1 optional layout property or state layout is deployment policy. Also crate side for po6q.2: start media in post-commit hooks, not inside create_object's atomic step; add a server-initiated media_report path via update_object_if. Mark's call on the spec items.
